I am the only person in the office so, if at all possible, call ahead to make sure I am in. When I do have to be gone there is no one to keep the office open. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Record Searching
Note: The Dade County Recorder’s Office does not do Title Searching for anyone or any reason. You are more than welcome to come search the records yourself or have someone come in. All records, indexing, and images back to 1972 are now on our e-search site. If you need a deed prior to 1972 you can still access this on the site but you will need a specific book and page number.
Begin Online Record Search
Deed Watch Registration
If you are concerned with real estate fraud, register here:
Click on the link deedwatch.com
Choose your county in the dropdown menu.
Enter your email address.
Enter the names you want to flag.
If you own real estate property in other counties, you will need to register for each county separately.
Marriage License: $53.00
You will need your driver’s license or government-issued ID and social security card.
Both parties must sign in front of the Recorder.
Must be 18 years old.
No one under the age of 18 will be issued a Marriage License. (Effective August 28, 2025)
